description: FREE Solidity security check (Slither). Detects known vulnerability patterns (reentrancy, unchecked calls, tx.origin auth, arbitrary ETH sends and more) and returns severity counts plus High/Medium detector names. Use after writing or changing a contract and before deployment. Input: {"sources": {"File.sol": "<source>"}} (include imported files). Max 60 kB; rate-limited per client. Zero findings does not mean safe.
name: scan_solidity_preview
